symbols.name: axis count
symbols.meaning: The number of axes of the array, which is also the number of coordinates in each address.
symbols.quote: An array with $D$ axes, where $D$ is the number of axes, has $D$ coordinates in each address.

symbols.name: axis coordinate
symbols.meaning: The coordinate of an address along axis $i$, an integer from 0 to $t_i - 1$.
symbols.quote: Along axis $i$ an address has a coordinate $x_i$ with $0 \le x_i < t_i$, where $t_i$, the length of axis $i$, is the number of values that coordinate takes.

symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The length of axis $i$, the number of values its coordinate takes.
symbols.quote: Along axis $i$ an address has a coordinate $x_i$ with $0 \le x_i < t_i$, where $t_i$, the length of axis $i$, is the number of values that coordinate takes.

symbols.name: modulus exponent
symbols.meaning: The power of two $s$ in the modulus $y^s+1$ of the polynomial that stores one coordinate.
symbols.quote: One coordinate is the coefficient list of a polynomial modulo $y^s+1$, where $s$ is that power of two,

symbols.name: polynomial indeterminate
symbols.meaning: The indeterminate of the polynomial modulo $y^s+1$; its powers serve as roots of unity on the remaining axes.
symbols.quote: Here $y$ is the indeterminate of a polynomial, and the letter $y$ changes meaning from the second input.

relations.quote: Along axis $i$ the array is transformed by a [discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md) of length $t_i$.
On the remaining axes the transform weights its entries by [roots of unity](root-of-unity.md) that are powers of $y$.
